caveats: No per-cell MHWs (>=5 consecutive hot days) were found, so no regional events. The summer 2004 SST in this region ran below the smoothed 90th-percentile threshold derived from the 1992-2002 baseline on nearly all days (region-mean offset about -0.38 K vs baseline climatology, -2.6 K on 2004-07-15; largest single-day positive margin +1.02 K on 2004-08-01). 117 hot cell-days occurred, longest run in any cell 2 days. 3303 of 3600 region cells are sea cells (finite on all 92 target days); all sea cells have fully defined thresholds. Land cells are set to 0 in the mask.
